commits.subject: World map LOD: coarse-chunk mode below zoom threshold, nearest texture filter
commits.body:
World map LOD: coarse-chunk mode below zoom threshold, nearest texture filter

- Add CoarseChunkSize (512 cells) LOD level: at zoom < 0.55 the whole visible
  window is served by max 8x16 coarse chunks instead of ~1300 fine chunks;
  SetCellsRect/mesh-rebuild count drops ~64x per covered area, giving a hard
  ceiling on tiles in TileMapLayer regardless of zoom-out.
- Hysteresis around the LOD threshold prevents mode flapping while scrolling
  the wheel near 0.55; SwitchLodMode does one atomic _mapLayer.Clear().
- FillCoarseChunkFromBaked batches per row (512 cells/batch), exact slices
  passed to SetCellsRect (no garbage tails); fine path now also uses [..n].
- TextureFilter = Nearest on the map layer: kills mip sampling cost and
  bilinear blur on the giant tile mesh at low zoom.
- CloseMap clears both LOD bookkeeping sets.

narrative.title: Многоуровневый LOD мировой карты: Грубые чанки (512 ячеек)
narrative.story: Решение проблемы просадки FPS при отдалении мировой карты. Добавлен режим coarse-chunk LOD (размер блока 512 клеток). При коэффициенте зума < 0.55 весь экран обслуживается всего 8-16 крупными блоками с фильтрацией nearest, что устранило микрофризы.
tech_highlights: Константа `CoarseChunkSize = 512` ячеек для макро-просмотра континентов
Переключение режимов рендеринга по пороговому значению zoom < 0.55

commits.author: qwen.ai[bot]
commits.subject: Refactor ConstructionPipeline with zone gating, active site tracking, and gateway cache
commits.body:
Refactor ConstructionPipeline with zone gating, active site tracking, and gateway cache

- Replaced counter-based resource tracking (`LogsNeeded`/`LogsDelivered`) with strict per-cell stage states (`CellStage`) to enforce 100% supply completion before building starts.
- Added `IsZoneWorkAllowed` gate using a TTL-cached `GatewayInfo` dictionary to efficiently block farming/hauling inside incomplete buildings without hot-path allocations.
- Introduced `_activeClearSites` HashSet to optimize `ReconcileTick` by only processing sites with pending clearing/supply tasks instead of iterating all sites.
- Implemented `OpenZoneJobs` logic to immediately reset job dispatcher cooldowns for zone cells upon wall completion, reducing agent idle time.
- Updated `NotifyWallBuilt` and `DropSiteLocked` to handle site completion state transitions and clean up global zone cell indices.

narrative.title: Жёсткий пайплайн строительства: Расчистка → Доставка → Сборка
narrative.story: Рефакторинг `ConstructionPipeline.cs`. Замена ненадёжных счётчиков ресурсов строгим автоматом состояний на каждую клетку (`ClearanceRequired` → `DeliveryRequired` → `ReadyToBuild`). Это полностью ликвидировало баг, когда колонисты строили стены поверх лежащих брёвен или деревьев.
tech_highlights: Поклеточный автомат стадий строительства вместо общих счётчиков стройплощадки
Кэш шлюзов `gateway cache` и отслеживание активных площадок
Автоматическая генерация задачи расчистки препятствий перед доставкой материалов

commits.subject: Fix WorldMapOverlay performance, crashes, and correctness issues - Replace dirty-state cache with loaded-chunk HashSet to skip biome recalculation for cached chunks - Correct visible area calculation by dividing viewport size by 2 for half-width/height cells - Fix InvalidOperationException during chunk unloading by collecting removals into a list before iteration - Add zoom and viewport size tracking to trigger LoadVisibleChunks on scale changes, not just position - Refactor CanvasLayer visibility handling to use Dictionary<CanvasLayer, bool> supporting multiple layers - Implement drag-stick protection in _Process by verifying actual mouse button state via Input.IsMouseButtonPressed - Optimize PullChunk loops to iterate only within valid grid bounds instead of full 64x64 range - Add tile index bounds check against AtlasCoordsCached length to prevent IndexOutOfRangeException - Use _mapLayer.Clear() for full cache reset instead of iterating all cells; extract EraseChunkCells helper - Unsubscribe close button signal in _ExitTree to prevent memory leaks
commits.body:
Fix WorldMapOverlay performance, crashes, and correctness issues
- Replace dirty-state cache with loaded-chunk HashSet to skip biome recalculation for cached chunks
- Correct visible area calculation by dividing viewport size by 2 for half-width/height cells
- Fix InvalidOperationException during chunk unloading by collecting removals into a list before iteration
- Add zoom and viewport size tracking to trigger LoadVisibleChunks on scale changes, not just position
- Refactor CanvasLayer visibility handling to use Dictionary<CanvasLayer, bool> supporting multiple layers
- Implement drag-stick protection in _Process by verifying actual mouse button state via Input.IsMouseButtonPressed
- Optimize PullChunk loops to iterate only within valid grid bounds instead of full 64x64 range
- Add tile index bounds check against AtlasCoordsCached length to prevent IndexOutOfRangeException
- Use _mapLayer.Clear() for full cache reset instead of iterating all cells; extract EraseChunkCells helper
- Unsubscribe close button signal in _ExitTree to prevent memory leaks

Implement seamless world generation v4 with absolute-coordinate noise layers

- Add WorldNoise.cs: pure C# gradient Perlin, fBm, ridged, and Voronoi generators using world coordinate hashing for chunk seamlessness
- Create layered world architecture in src/core/world/layers/: ReliefLayer (domain-warped elevation), ClimateLayer (temperature/precipitation with rain shadow), HydrologyLayer (priority-flood river/lake detection per region cache), VegetationLayer (stone/soil/tree logic), BiomeClassifier (Whittaker diagram)
- Introduce WorldLayerStack as unified multi-layer generator providing MacroCell and LocalCellSample APIs; define WorldLayerParams constants for all generation thresholds
- Implement LocalMapBuilder to construct playable game areas from the global WorldLayerStack, ensuring spawn safety via land search and start clearing
- Refactor MapGenerator.cs to delegate standard generation to LocalMapBuilder by default while retaining legacy island fallback; mark GenerateRegion obsolete in favor of direct layer sampling
- Update .gitignore to exclude Godot Mono build artifacts (.godot/mono/temp/) and remove numerous backup files (.bak_*) from src/ui/streaming/

Acceptance tests for world generator v4: chunk seams, determinism, and realism metrics
- Added `tests/Program.cs` with comprehensive validation for chunk boundary consistency, deterministic sampling order, extreme coordinate handling, and performance benchmarks (32x32 chunk < 3ms).
- Implemented realism checks for water/mountain ratios, river/lake presence, forest-tree correlation, and desert tree scarcity within a 128x128 window.
- Created `tests/WorldSeamTests.csproj` to compile core world layers, streaming generation, and hydrology modules without UI dependencies.
- Refactored `src/core/world/layers/HydrologyLayer.cs` cache mechanism from concurrent dictionary with bulk clear to LRU policy limited to one region (~5MB) for stable memory usage during streaming.
- Updated `HydrologyLayer.ComputeRegion` to pass region size `S` to `RegionData` record and fixed height clamping logic in `Accumulate` to prevent flow collapse in low-elevation areas.
- Modified `src/core/world/LocalMapBuilder.cs` to include `Game.Core.WorldStreaming` namespace reference.
